messages:
kevin_sales: Quick sync: NimbusAI wants a POC to validate 'nimbus-14b-edge' + a q5-lite quant variant for orchestration. They asked for catalog fit, streaming latency, KV/cache compatibility, sec questionnaire responses (BYOK/HSM/residency), and a brief POC price. Can we triage?

amira_se: I'll own fidelity and variant checks. Do they mainly send short control tokens or long transcripts?

kevin_sales: Mostly short commands (~15-40 tokens) with rare 1k token attachments for context. Very bursty.

sam_infra: Note: nimbus-14b-edge behaves well with compact-kv for avg loads but tail spikes on mixed long contexts. Recommend bench both compact and hybrid-kv.

ton y_sec: Security flagged BYOK + EU residency optional; they want confirmation of artifact scans. Hosted POC OK, Dedicated if HSM required.

jules_prod: For hosted POC we can do KMS passthrough. I'll draft questionnaire wording and a POC one-pager once we confirm deployment mode.

deploy-bot: Starting ephemeral job #9912 for nimbus-14b-edge (v1.0).

sam_infra: Suggested bench (internal):

```bash
redwood-bench --model nimbus-14b-edge --variant q5-lite,float16 --kv-layout compact-kv,hybrid-kv --seq-dist nimbus-mix.json --concurrency 12 --streaming true --measure p95,p99,tokens_per_sec
```

sam_infra: Quick smoke: short-only p95 float16 ~80ms, q5-lite ~110ms. Mixed with 1k spikes p95 float16 ~420ms, q5-lite ~680ms at concurrency 12. Hybrid-kv shaved p99 by ~14% but cost ~9% tokens/sec.

amira_se: I'll request a 40-prompt eval set from NimbusAI to run deterministic diffs between float16 and q5-lite. We should quantify token-level deltas, especially for numeric/command parsing.

ton y_sec: Draft security reply: "Hosted POC: customer-managed KMS via passthrough; encryption in transit and at rest; artifact checksum and internal scans performed. HSM-backed keys available on Dedicated/Private deployments; third-party attestations can be scoped."

jules_prod: Pricing sketch: 1-week hosted POC block with a discounted token bucket and optional Dedicated uplift for HSM. Sharing numbers offline.

kevin_sales: Timeline: NimbusAI demo targeted Friday. Can we have bench + sec answers + pricing by Thu EOD?

sam_infra: Action recap: @amira_se run fidelity diffs when prompts arrive; @sam_infra post full bench logs and mitigation checklist; @tony_sec finalize questionnaire answers & attach audit summary; @jules_prod prepare the POC price card. Deliver Thu EOD.

amira_se: CSM said prompts will be uploaded today. I'll run diffs once available and post a short delta summary.

deploy-bot: Job #9912 succeeded: nimbus-14b-edge v1.0 deployed on dev-ephemeral. Logs archived.
